decisions.reason: The organic salami platter has stayed on the website for two years and fits the firm's growing organic line, so it is likely a steady seller even though it is no longer featured prominently.
The premium sharing snack was extended with a poultry variant in 2024, which signals continued investment, although it moved from its own page to a mention and snack lines face high churn in retail.
The organic Fleischwurst was only launched in 2024, has its own page, and extends a core German sausage category into organic, so the firm will give it time to build listings.
The thinly sliced organic chicken breast launched in 2024 in two variants with dedicated promotion and fits the trend toward poultry, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.
The organic herb-coated salami is a recent 2024 launch with its own page that builds on the firm's salami expertise, so it will most likely stay on the market.
